name: Front
description: Front is described by the vendor as "the AI customer operations platform," integrating shared team inboxes, ticketing, and AI tools to handle complex, cross-team customer support workflows.
best_for: Positioned for organizations with complex customer operations spanning support, operations, inbound sales, account management, and customer success teams (9,300+ companies), in industries like financial services, tech, logistics, manufacturing, and travel.
features: Shared inboxes for team email collaboration
Autopilot automation and Copilot AI assistant for complex requests
Smart QA and Smart CSAT (AI-driven quality/satisfaction scoring)
Omnichannel inbox including live chat and ticketing

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually (saves 24% vs monthly). Capped at 10 seats. Single-channel support, basic analytics.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually. Capped at 50 seats. Omnichannel, SSO/SCIM, advanced analytics.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Per seat/month, billed annually. Unlimited seats, most popular tier. Requires a sales demo; onboarding packages mandatory for contracts over $25k.

cons: Starter is hard-capped at 10 seats and Professional at 50 seats -- growing past those limits forces an upgrade, not just a seat add-on.
AI features (Copilot, Smart QA, Smart CSAT) are paid add-ons ($10-20/seat/month each) on Starter and Professional; only Enterprise bundles them in.

alternatives.name: Help Scout
alternatives.description: A customer service platform centralizing email and other channels into a shared inbox with AI drafting.
alternatives.best_for: SaaS, ecommerce, and services teams wanting a simpler shared-inbox tool.

alternatives.name: Intercom
alternatives.description: A customer service platform pairing a full helpdesk with Fin, a natively integrated AI agent.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting AI-agent-led resolution alongside human conversations.
